scope: D3 multipart storage and D1b Helm catalog hook; no production or remote deployment

latest_targeted.scope: multipart/native writer, preparation atomic outputs, real MinIO IAM and conditional commit

earlier_multipart_dataset_api.note: Before final profiling and reservoir changes; superseded in those scopes by latest targeted tests.

sample.byte_overflow_behavior: uniformly reduce selected indices and rescan; no head truncation
sample.qualification: Targeted uniform wide-sample/reproducibility tests plus final >3 GiB native-writer MinIO benchmark; seeded 42 reservoir: 1250 rows, 5175351 encoded bytes, 6.355 seconds.

limitations: Spark/Unity interoperability and production bucket migration/IAM application have not been qualified here.
The 3248348018-byte dataset is synthetic (790528 rows, int64 id plus unique fixed-size binary payload 4096), not a production ML benchmark.

Final native volume client was in a real 4 GiB / 2 CPU cgroup; MinIO had its own 512 MiB / 1 CPU cgroup. memory.peak=4297986048 bytes includes cache and transient cgroup accounting; memory.events reported max 32177, oom 0, oom_kill 0. This is not a process-tree RSS measurement. Profiling used one thread, 1 GiB DuckDB memory, 4 GiB spill and 4 GiB virtual-memory rlimit.
Official pinned MinIO/mc release binaries with verified SHA256 ran in a local Python carrier container after direct MinIO image registries were unavailable; this is not proof of a production image.

Historical d3-minio-volume.json used manual journal actions and head sample, with external RSS supervision only. It remains preserved and is superseded by d3-native-minio-volume.json for the final implementation.
Earlier tmpfs/OOM and concurrent outer-cgroup-pressure attempts are excluded from qualified performance. Full-column profiling refusals from attempts 5/6 remain in d3-profile-refused-attempts.json.
The Helm hook is rendered/tested only; it has not applied a catalog or run on a cluster.

writer.implementation: PyArrow bounded multipart encoding followed by delta-rs native convert_to_deltalake; empty outputs use DeltaTable.create
writer.remote_publication: unchanged native commit bytes uploaded after parts via S3 If-None-Match:*
writer.D-21: Native commit implementation replaces the manual journal; follows write-parts-then-commit path of plan section 29.3.
